name: Stockstadt am Rhein (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, white and red with a broad white middle stripe, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Stockstadt am Rhein (crossed tools and a wheel on red).
history: Municipal flag of Stockstadt am Rhein; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Stockstadt am Rhein arms — tools and wheel on red
